summary: The C-03 retry modal now satisfies the active wireframe contract for this audit. It is reachable from /practice/problems through an existing in-progress row, keeps the dimmed problem-list background, shows a three-item problem summary, presents three retry-mode options with one selected and unavailable modes disabled, and keeps the footer action pair fixed to cancel/start. The previous third footer CTA for result viewing was moved out of the decision footer; submitted-result access remains a contextual summary action and is covered by component tests.
acceptedVariance: The hifi image includes richer illustrated cards, previous-score/time fields, and an answer-preview toggle. The screen-data-summary gives description.md priority, and the active data contract does not require adding those net-new fields for this audit.

The live audit account exposed an in-progress row, so screenshots show the resume path. The submitted-result path is preserved as a contextual action and verified in tests/components/practice/RetryModal.test.tsx.
Next dev indicator may appear in local screenshots. It is not product UI and is excluded from visual severity.

findings.claim: Resolved: the modal is reachable from the authenticated C-02 problem list.
findings.observed: The audit capture found one retry trigger on /practice/problems?solve=inProgress and opened the modal at 360, 768, and 1280 widths.
findings.expected: C-03 is a hosted modal entered from C-02 when a learner selects a previously attempted problem.

findings.claim: Resolved: the modal summarizes the selected problem in three compact fields.
findings.observed: The modal shows problem title, question type, and previous state with attempt count and recency. Long titles remain clipped to 28 characters in source.
findings.expected: The description requires selected title, type, and previous solve state with no more than three summary items.

findings.claim: Resolved: retry mode selection exposes three modes with one valid default selected.
findings.observed: The capture manifest records three radio options. In the in-progress row, resume is selected, fresh is available, and hint mode is visibly disabled as deferred.
findings.expected: The modal should show up to three retry modes, one default selection, and disabled unavailable choices.

findings.claim: Resolved: the footer decision area is fixed to cancel/start.
findings.observed: The prior third footer action was removed. The audited footerButtons are [취소, 시작] at 360, 768, and 1280 widths.
findings.expected: The C-03 description requires exactly two CTA actions: cancel returns to the list and start opens the writing route for the selected mode.

findings.claim: Resolved: the modal renders stably across audited breakpoints.
findings.observed: The custom Playwright capture opened the modal at 360, 768, and 1280 widths with status 200, errorOverlay=false, and consoleErr=0.
findings.expected: The modal should preserve focus/context over the dimmed C-02 page without runtime errors, text collision, or lost footer actions.

verification.result: passed; 7 tests cover footer CTA count, start route, recoverable start failure, result-route paths, and cancel behavior
